components.name: Primary Button
components.description: High-contrast action for the next task step.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { color: var(--surface); background: var(--green); border: 1px solid var(--green); border-radius: 2px; padding: 10px 16px; font: 700 13px/1.15 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .18s ease, transform .18s ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--green-dark); border-color: var(--green-dark); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--green-dark); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet alternative action with a clear outline.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { color: var(--ink); background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid #777; border-radius: 2px; padding: 10px 16px; font: 700 13px/1.15 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .18s ease, border-color .18s ease; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: var(--surface-muted); border-color: #444; } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--green-dark); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Search a place or record while keeping the main action nearby.
components.css: .ds-search { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: var(--ink); font: 600 12px/1.4 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-search input { min-width: 0; height: 44px; padding: 0 11px; color: var(--text); background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid #777; border-radius: 0; font: 400 14px/1.5 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: var(--muted); opacity: 1; } .ds-search input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--green-dark); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Compact black navigation with one green active marker.
components.html: AidLocateHomeFind KitsMap
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 22px; min-height: 56px; padding: 0 16px; color: var(--on-dark-muted); background: var(--ink); font: 600 12px/1.3 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { position: relative; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav .ds-active { color: var(--green-light); } .ds-nav .ds-active::after { position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: -19px; left: 0; height: 3px; background: var(--green); content: ''; } .ds-nav .ds-brand { margin-right: auto; color: var(--surface); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--green-light); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Sample Notice
components.description: Unmissable context for unverified sample coordinates.
components.html: Sample locations only. Public access has not been verified.
components.css: .ds-sample-notice { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 9px; padding: 11px 14px; color: var(--ink); background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--ink); font: 400 12px/1.5 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-sample-notice svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; flex: none; margin-top: 1px; fill: var(--ink); }

components.css: .ds-result { padding: 14px 12px; color: var(--text); background: var(--surface); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-result-meta { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; color: var(--ink); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .05em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-result-meta strong { color: var(--ink); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-result h3 { margin: 8px 0 4px; color: var(--ink); font: 600 24px/1.05 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; } .ds-result p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-result-actions { display: flex; gap: 8px; margin-top: 12px; } .ds-result-actions button, .ds-result-actions a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 33px; padding: 7px 10px; border: 1px solid #777; border-radius: 2px; color: var(--ink); background: var(--surface); font: 700 11px/1.2 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-result-actions button { color: var(--surface); background: var(--green); border-color: var(--green); cursor: pointer; } .ds-result-actions button:focus-visible, .ds-result-actions a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--green-dark); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
AidLocate borrows the direct hierarchy of a contemporary Mumbai suburban railway display: strong condensed headlines, aligned information rows, a black-and-white field, and deliberate green and red signals. The reference is an information system, not a station replica; the interface uses no invented routes or nostalgic decoration.

The interface is an operational tool for people who may be using a phone in a public place and under time pressure. Keep actions easy to scan, make location data legible, and make uncertainty visible. Green identifies actions and selected states; red is reserved for urgent and error states. Kit coordinates are sample records, so their labels and markers stay monochrome and never suggest availability.
keyCharacteristics: High-contrast, code-led hierarchy with Barlow Condensed display type.
Flat white surfaces framed by fine dividers rather than stacked rounded cards.
Green for primary actions and selected states; red for urgent and error states.
Compact navigation and aligned destination-style result rows.

rules.name: Sample-Is-Not-Status Rule
rules.body: Green marks actions and selected states, red marks urgent or error states, and monochrome labels identify unverified sample records. No color implies that a first-aid kit is confirmed available.

rules.name: Data-First Type Rule
rules.body: Use condensed display type for hierarchy, never for caveats, forms, or long location text.

dos: Do put the task, location action, and sample-data caveat before the /find map and results.
Do use Barlow Condensed for short display headlines and IBM Plex Sans for operational copy.
Do keep IDs and distances tabular and aligned for quick comparison.
Do label sample coordinates directly wherever kit results or markers appear.
donts: Don't use green or red to imply a kit is stocked, verified, or available.
Don't invent real transit routes, locations, facility claims, or delivery states.
Don't rebuild pages from repeated rounded icon cards or decorative gradients.
Don't hide the sample-data caveat below the map or result list.
